en: Fixed `--permission-mode auto` or a settings `defaultMode: auto` starting in a mode that could allow more when auto mode was unavailable. It now starts in Manual mode, which asks first
zh: 修复了 `--permission-mode auto` 或设置中的 `defaultMode: auto` 在自动模式不可用时以可能允许更多操作的权限模式启动的问题。现在会以 Manual 模式启动，先进行询问
